comments:
One workaround is to go through json and explode/unnest

```
(
    pl.select(
        a=pl.lit(json.dumps([{"key":[{"value":1},{"value":1.0}]}]))
        )
    .select(pl.col('a').str.json_decode().explode())
    .unnest('a')
    )
```

If you explode and unnest `key` as well then it properly finds the common f64

review_comments: This was the key to the issue - calling `extract` on `Wrap<AnyValue>` defaults to strict.
